reason: The commit changes only the internal frequency of socket-pool loop registration inside h2o_context_init, from process-wide once-only registration to registration for every initialized context. It introduces no new entry point, API argument, configuration requirement, state prerequisite, or input constraint. The existing HTTP harness already calls h2o_context_init with an initialized loop and configuration, so its setup remains valid. Although the harness creates only one context and therefore does not specifically distinguish the old and new multi-context behavior, the change does not make the harness inadequate for invoking the changed production path.
evidence: The removed static `once` guard previously wrapped `h2o_socketpool_register_loop(&ctx->globalconf->proxy.global_socketpool, loop)`.
The new code calls the same `h2o_socketpool_register_loop` with the same arguments on every `h2o_context_init` invocation.
`fuzz/driver.cc` already creates a loop using `h2o_evloop_create()` and invokes `h2o_context_init(&ctx, loop, &config)`.
No public function signature, request-processing entry point, fuzz-input format, or configuration field is added or changed.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harness unchanged; multi-context regression testing may be appropriate as a conventional unit test, but this commit does not require fuzz-harness maintenance.
